entities.description: A young woman with voluminous dark curly hair and round wire-rimmed glasses sits cross-legged on a grey sofa, wearing a lavender satin pajama set with white piping. She has a neutral expression and is looking directly at the camera with her hands resting on her feet.

entities.description: A square, cream-colored throw pillow with a textured, woven fabric featuring a subtle grid pattern rests against a dark gray sofa backrest. In the lower left foreground, a blurry, glossy purple object partially obscures the view of the pillow.
